title: C. Minimum on Subarrays
statement:
There is a variable sum, which is initially equal to 0.

There is also a data structure that can perform the following operations:

The operations popback, popfront, and min cannot be applied to an empty structure!

Using this structure, you would like to be able to find the sum of the minimums of all non-empty subarrays of an array a of n elements.

More formally, your task is to find a sequence of no more than n·(n + 2) commands such that after all operations, the variable sum will be equal to ∑_{0 ≤ l ≤ r < n} min(a[l],…, a[r]) for any possible array a.

The first line contains a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 500) — the number of elements in the array.

Output k (1 ≤ k ≤ n·(n + 2)) commands. Each command must be one of the following five lines:

If there are multiple valid answers, output any.

Input:
```
1
```

Output:
```
3
pushback a[0]
min
popfront
```

Input:
```
2
```

Output:
```
6
pushfront a[1]
min
pushback a[0]
min
popfront
min
```
